title: About2
text:
We would like to present to you OyOy - a restaurant with spectacular 180 degree views on Spinola Bay.

Our Mediterranean Cuisine will take you on a gastronomic journey that will guarantee you an exquisite tasting experience.

We cook with love. We make tasty homemade organic food. We use really good, natural ingredients to create dishes that are delicious and good for you. We like using fresh vegetables from local farms. We think it's important to have food that's not only tasty but also doesn't have any bad chemicals.

Each dish is made carefully to make sure it's not just good to eat but also makes you feel warm inside. We're proud to serve meals that show how much we care about what we do. We will help you to enhance the special moments in your life - having lunch and dinner, celebrating holidays and organizing private events!
